sources.title: Model-agnostic Retrieval-Augmented Extended Forecasting for time series
sources.snippet: We present Retrieval-Augmented Extended Forecasting (RAEF), a model-agnostic approach for time series fore-casting that addresses the limitations of RAF with two key refinements.
